authority: Static organizational policy for state, House, private, personal and mercenary military organizations. Exact manpower, formations, represented people, casualties, operations, ownership, appointments and support allocations remain in their native campaign owners.

officer_representation_policy.high_potential_evidence_rule: High potential is never inferred from holding a billet. It requires saved screening, cohort, progression, performance or other exact provenance before it can justify individual representation.
officer_representation_policy.materialization_rule: Materializing an internal officer reclassifies one already conserved body from the exact owning force or formation. Representation never adds manpower.

persistent_formation.rule: formation.personnel is fighting establishment. Unit command and separately attached support may sit above fighting strength only when exact conserved owner-force allocations prove those bodies.

mercenary_company.rule: Mercenary headcount is total company personnel. Command and support are carved from that already conserved total by default. They do not increase company headcount unless a separate exact external attachment owner proves additional bodies.

unit_command.rule: The persistent unit commander and formal unit deputy are command-establishment personnel above the fighting-strength number for normal formations. They must still be conserved real people from an owning or lawfully attached force and never arise from narration.

deputy_policy.succession_rule: When an internal commander is lost and no formal deputy exists, the best lawful subordinate commander may become acting commander; promotion never creates a body.

formation_command_structure.external_support_rule: For normal persistent formations, support personnel are outside fighting establishment and must be allocated from conserved owner-force roles. They increase attached headcount but not fighting strength or persistent unit slots.
formation_command_structure.internal_officer_rule: Every internal command node is an assignment held by a soldier already inside the formation's fighting establishment. Materializing that commander converts one anonymous formation body into a represented person; it does not increase formation personnel.
formation_command_structure.temporary_subdivision_rule: A persistent cohort or internal command may be divided temporarily for battlefield control without rewriting the conserved cohort ledger or creating another persistent formation.

mercenary_command_structure.rule: Mercenary command nodes use the same scale-aware hierarchy, but generic officers remain aggregate. Unit command and support come from the company's existing total headcount unless a separate lawful attachment is saved. Important, exceptional or provenance-backed high-potential officers may later be materialized without changing total company manpower.

unit_command.deputy_rule: A deputy primarily improves continuity and throughput. A deputy is not an unrestricted additive stat bonus and cannot duplicate the commander's scale effects.

formation_qin_border_line.label: QIN Border Line
formation_qin_border_line.hierarchy_rule: Four 2,000-man commands each contain two 1,000-man commands; each 1,000 contains two 500-man commands; each 500 contains five 100-man commands. All 108 subordinate command assignments are held by soldiers inside the same conserved 8,000 fighting establishment.

formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.label: Great Bow Guard
formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.officer_source_rule: Internal Great Bow Guard commanders and the normal deputy candidate pool arise from the accepted conserved Great Bow Guard recruitment body. Sword Manor personnel are not transferred unless Tang Wei explicitly orders a lawful secondment.
formation_tang_wei_great_bow_guard_first.temporary_100_rule: A 200-man Great Bow Guard cohort may tactically divide into two temporary 100-man groups without changing persistent cohort conservation or unit-slot count.

operation_depth.rule: Major operations may coordinate several complementary persistent formations when exact available formations and authority permit. The operation layer never merges their manpower, casualties, officers, equipment or ownership.

great_bow_guard.rule: The 3,000-fighter Great Bow Guard remains one persistent formation. Three 1,000-man command nodes and fifteen 200-man command nodes are internal assignments over the same 15 conserved 200-person cohorts. Their commanders consume existing Great Bow Guard bodies. The unit commander and formal deputy sit above fighting strength, and any support attachment is separately conserved outside fighting strength.
